meta.name: WWE Superstar Central: WWE Rivals
meta.description:
WWE Superstar Central is the 24/7 destination to experience WWE mania like never before. Learn the untold stories from the ring's biggest Legends, and get a backstage pass to WWE's biggest events and longest running rivalries.

Shows: WWE Rivals, Biography: WWE Legends, WWE's Most Wanted Treasures, WWE Smack Talk, WWE's Greatest Moments
Available on: Samsung TV Plus
